title: 1/3 screen overlays

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Reserve only the space needed for explanation so the image can remain the main subject.
strategic_value: A compact third-width panel can carry Helsinki information while keeping more of the scene visible.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture compares an upper-left green text panel with a centered orange panel on the right of photographic footage.
practical_value: Use a one-third panel when a short explanation must coexist with a larger image.

content_islands.name: Placement rule
content_islands.spec: State protected-area, side and color options before the examples.

content_islands.name: Two third-width examples
content_islands.spec: Pair each left or right panel with its alignment and type-size note.

ingredient.name: One-third video overlay
ingredient.application: Place a color panel left or right with centered or upper-left text inside the safe area.
ingredient.scope: One-third overlays; templates use 80 px text and 96 px line spacing.

reference_purposes.Application: The two templates show a left upper-aligned panel and a right centered panel.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Text remains inside the protected area.
reference_purposes.Expression: Green and orange color blocks frame white or dark text beside city imagery.
